messages:
Ravi (prod): Quick checkpoint on Console observability launch scope. We need consensus on minimal launch vs stretch. Keeping customers happy (Nucleus, Finlytics) but not bloating infra.
Sofia M: Quick thoughts: minimal = dashboard templates + daily cost rollups + basic error groups. Stretch = interactive trace links + per-tenant drilldowns + anomaly detection.
Jared L: We should define clear perf gates. Minimal queries <3s for 30d, dashboard render <1.5s for small result sets. Stretch might need dedicated query nodes.
Priya K: Sampling plan: default 0.1% full traces, rule-based 5% for errors, 2% for routes with p99>1s. Opt-in toggle per-customer.
Ethan R: Cost note: keeping full traces for 30d is expensive. Recommend storing only aggregates for 90d and raw traces for 7d.
Ravi (prod): Can we make those retention numbers a launch policy? 7d raw, 90d aggregates. Add per-tenant override for enterprise customers.
telemetry-bot: new doc: https://go.redwood/obs/launch-policy uploaded (auto)
Sofia M: Acceptance checklist proposal (minimal):
- Dashboards: 3 templates (latency, tokens/cost, errors) with sample data
- Cost rollups: per-model + per-route daily buckets
- Error groups: top 20 signatures, sample trace link when available
- Query perf: 95th latency under 3s for 30d window
- Security: data access controls + per-tenant scoping
Jared L: Also add: rollout plan = staged by org size. Start with internal + 3 beta customers, then 20 early access orgs, then gradual ramp.
Priya K: For tracing hooks, config suggestion:
```json
{"hooks": [{"name":"err-trace","condition":{"error":true},"sample":0.05},{"name":"slow-trace","condition":{"duration_ms_gt":800},"sample":0.02}]}
```
Olga S: UX ask: dashboards should have persistent filters (model, region, org) and a share button. Also saveable views. That reduces support tickets.
Ethan R: Ops constraint: we need to cap query concurrency per-tenant. Propose soft quota 10 qps and queue beyond that with 5s timeout.
Ravi (prod): Good points. Let's lock minimal schema now. If schema changes later it'll be hard. Priya/Tom we need a short migration strategy.
Priya K: I'll draft a schema diff and backward-compatible ingestion plan. No reingestion for launch.
Jared L: I'll mock perf test harness and run 30d synthetic workload to validate 95th percentile.
Sofia M: Can we put a gate: if cost estimate > 2x budget, we delay stretch features?
Ethan R: Yep. Kevin (cost) can run numbers. If cost delta > target, we'll keep tracing canary-only.
telemetry-bot: meeting added: Obs Launch Scope Review Fri 11:00 (calendar)
Ravi (prod): Action items:
- Priya: schema diff + migration notes (owner)
- Jared: perf harness + estimate (owner)
- Sofia: acceptance checklist doc + dashboard mocks (owner)
- Ethan: cost forecast and quota plan (owner)
- Olga: UX save/share prototype (owner)
We'll reconvene Fri 11 and aim for a launch cut by end of next sprint if scores look good.
Olga S: noted. I'll prototype a single-panel share link.
Priya K: I'll post schema diff by Wed EOD.
Jared L: Running initial perf runs now, will post numbers by Thu.
Sofia M: I'll assemble the checklist and tag beta customers for opt-in.
Ravi (prod): Thanks everyone. Keep comments inline on the doc. :thumbsup:
